name: react-wp
description: A React-based WordPress alternative that replaces the traditional PHP approach with a modern React architecture, including essential CMS tools and configurations.

paragraphs: A lightweight, modular, WordPress-style CMS built on React 19, Vite and Supabase.
Familiar to WordPress users (Setup Wizard, roles, plugins, themes, page builder, media library), but a single-page app on top of Postgres instead of a monolith on top of PHP.
Key Features · Architecture · Deployment · Quick Start · Security · Reference
features: Each plugin that owns tables ships schema.sql (run on activation) and uninstall.sql (run only when an administrator explicitly wipes its data). A site that never enables the shop never gets its shop tables.
Floating launcher on every public page (afterfooter slot), plus [rwpchatbox] to place
it on specific pages and [rwpinlinechat] for a whole conversation embedded in a page — both also exist as Page Builder widgets.
AI assistant powered by Google Gemini, answering from the site's own published pages and,
on a product page, the product's real title/price/stock. It never invents a price, a policy, or a delivery promise, and never asks for payment details.

whatItDoes.text: A lightweight, modular, WordPress-style CMS built on React 19, Vite and Supabase.

requirements.text: The last step is the same screen on every target, and it is the one place the installer admits what it did: it names the administrator it created and the role that account's profiles row actually carries (a promotion that matched no account is reported as a warning, instead of the site silently keeping the subscriber row handlenewuser gives every sign-up), lists each variable…
A persistent directory for data/ if you self-host
Sign-in goes browser → Supabase, so the anti-bot check on login, register and comments runs before the request.
Costs nothing, needs no third party, catches most form spam.

Because RLS protects systemsettings, the server needs a way in: DATABASEURL (a direct PostgreSQL connection — one of the five infrastructure variables), SUPABASESECRETKEY, or, on a self-hosted MySQL/SQLite/LibSQL site, its own database driver.
Orders of someone without an account here keep their billing details and come back to that person through the existing guest-order claim when they sign up with that email.
